headline: Eli Lilly (LLY) Joins Illumina’s Billion Cell Atlas For AI Drug Discovery
summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) has joined Illumina's Billion Cell Atlas alliance as a foundational participant. The alliance is building what is described as the world's largest genome-wide genetic perturbation dataset. The Billion Cell Atlas is sequencing hundreds of millions of cells to map disease mechanisms and find new drug targets. Eli Lilly enters this genomic data effort with a stock that has seen very strong multi year appreciation. NYSE:LLY is trading at $1,210.02, with the share price up...
